Buy a Belgian ID Card on Telegram

Somebody is selling a Belgian id card on Telegram right now and the advert almost certainly quotes a price below 85–290 EUR. Whether that price is honest depends on what is in the envelope, not on how confident the seller sounds.

Document type
An ID card is a domestic identity document issued by a civil registry, police force or municipal office. It proves identity inside the country and usually nothing outside it.

buy belgian id card on telegram – the short version

The band you should expect for a Belgian id card is 85–290 EUR. Below the bottom you are buying a print and should be told so. Above the top you should be getting a number that was registered rather than invented.

The figure above is a range rather than a quote, and it moves with stock and season. Hold it in your head as a filter, not as a target, and treat every deviation as a claim to be tested.

Buy a ID Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

Payment is usually a transfer or a crypto address and neither is reversible. Split it: a deposit for the data page photo, the balance against a tracking number that moves.

A live video call is worth ten photos. Ask the seller to hold the card to a window in daylight and tilt it slowly. The ghost image and the laminate edge are both visible on a call and neither can be staged with a print.

Who actually issues a ID Card

the commune is the body to check against. If a seller cannot name the office that issued the document in the photo, the photo is probably borrowed from a stock gallery.

Where no public route exists, the physical checks carry all the weight. That is not ideal, but it is the honest position and any seller who claims otherwise is overselling.

Replica or registered original

A registered original is a document whose number sits in the office records. It may still be a genuine book with your details typed in, but the number resolves, and that is the whole difference in value.

That is why the number should be requested before any payment. If a seller sends the number first and invites you to check it, you are talking to somebody confident about the register.

What a fair price looks like

The bottom of the 85–290 EUR band buys a data page print. The middle buys correct stock and the right print method. The top buys a number that resolves at the commune. Ask which one is quoted.

Delivery is part of the price and worth separating. Tracked delivery costs the seller money, and a quote that excludes it is not comparable to one that includes it.

The buying process, step by step

The sequence below is the one that keeps you protected. Run it in order and do not skip ahead to payment.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the commune.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the commune uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 85–290 EUR band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

Run these before money moves. Each one targets a feature that survives handling but not a photocopier.

  • Check the electronic identity card for a working chip and confirm the national number modulo ninety seven checksum.
  • Confirm the passport data page and the chip symbol on the cover.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the commune. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • An identity card with a national number that fails the modulo ninety seven check.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much is an ID card on Telegram?

Between 90 and 500 US dollars. A print sits at the bottom, a chip card with a valid number at the top.

Is an ID card worth buying at all?

It is the cheapest document to fake convincingly, so it is also the one most often faked badly. Buy it only with a number check.

Do ID cards work abroad?

Inside the issuing country, yes. Outside it, most are only accepted as secondary evidence.

What is the giveaway on a fake ID?

The number. It is the one part that has to obey a rule, and sellers who invent numbers rarely know the rule.

Can I check an ID number myself?

In most countries yes, because the algorithm is published. Search for the country name and check digit.
